name: BlueMove DEX
rootCause: BlueMove DEX was exploited on Sui on 11 July 2026 through an LP token accounting vulnerability, draining approximately $525,000 worth of assets across nearly 400 liquidity pools. Funds were converted and moved out of Sui before pools were frozen, enabling continued token drainage from broken pools. A liquidity-provider share accounting bug in BlueMove's legacy AMM implementation allowed an attacker to inflate LP token balances and withdraw more assets than they should have held. Cross-version desynchronization further exposed nearly 400 pools, which were left unfrozen after the main exploit.
